title: Coot
blurb: Coots are medium-sized water birds that are members of the rail family, Rallidae. They constitute the genus Fulica, the name being the Latin term for "coot".
facts: Coots have predominantly black plumage, and—unlike many rails—they are usually easy to see, often swimming in open water.
